timeline.evidenceText: God is not a man, that he should lie,
Delilah said to Samson, “Behold, you have mocked me, and told me lies. Now please tell me how you might be bound.”
Delilah said to Samson, “Until now, you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me with what you might be bound.”
He said, “At this season, when the time comes around, you will embrace a son.”
Now therefore be pleased to look at me,
If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar,
Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar.
“Can you draw out Leviathan* Leviathan is a name for a crocodile or similar creature. with a fish hook,
But they flattered him with their mouth,
A truthful witness will not lie,
Don’t you add to his words,
and Yahweh will guide you continually,

You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die, and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’
If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies:
For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it; because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

definitions.short: to lie (i.e. deceive ), literally or figuratively
definitions.usage: fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain.
definitions.full: H3576. kazab [ כָּזַב ] verb lie, be a liar (Arabic ; Aramaic כְּדַב , id. chiefly Pa`el; Late Hebrew כָּזַב ) — Qal Participle כֹּזֵב כָּלהָֿאָדָם Psa 116:11 (compare כָּזָּב 62:10 ). Niph`al Perfect 3feminine singular נִכְזָ֑בָה תֹּחַלְתּוֺ Job 41:1 his hope has been made deceptive , i.e. been shewn to be so; 2 masculine singular consecutive וְנִכְזָ֑בְתָּ Prov 30:6 lest he convict thee and thou be proven a liar. Pi`el Perfect 3masculine singular כִּזֵּב Micah 2:11 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יְכַזֵּב Hab 2:3 ; Prov 14:5 ; וִיכַזֵּב Num 23:19 , etc.; Infinitive construct suffix כַזֶּבְכֶם ( בְּ ) Ezek 13:19 ; — 1 lie, tell a lie , absolute, Num 23:19 (JE), Micah 2:11 ; Job 6:28 ; 34:6 ; Prov 14:5 ; Isa 57:11 ; followed by לְ person lie to Ezek 13:9 ; Psa 78:36 ; 89:36 ; followed by בְּ person tell a lie with , i.e. in intercourse, conversation with 2Kin 4:16 . 2 disappoint, fail , of a divine revelation Hab 2:3 ; waters of a spring Isa 58:11 . Hiph`il Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יַכְזִיבֵנִי Job 24:25 who will make me a liar ? i.e. prove me to be so (compare Niph`al )
